name: @local/python-env-manager
description: Pick a Python interpreter per conversation from the DSH input toolbar; the conversation and its subagents run Python with it, without changing system PATH. Local discovery covers conda, venv, PATH, and Termux; SSH remote interpreters from ~/.ssh/config hosts are offered too and stay unselectable when none are reachable.

scripts.test: node discover.test.mjs && node ssh.test.mjs && node host.test.mjs && node client.test.mjs
